description_en: Calls the DeleteConsumerGroup operation to delete a consumer group
description_zh: 调用 DeleteConsumerGroup 删除 ConsumerGroup
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka delete-consumer-group --instance-id alikafka_post-cn-mp91a44k0000 --consumer-id testconsumer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteConsumerGroup

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call GetInstanceList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94533.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.13.50a75a5f5ediNK#concept-94533-zh) to retrieve the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例 ID。

可调用 GetInstanceList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94533.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.13.50a75a5f5ediNK#concept-94533-zh) 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the consumer group.

The name can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length. Names longer than 64 characters are automatically truncated.
The name cannot be modified after the consumer group is created
parameters.help_zh:
Consumer Group 名称。

只能包含字母、数字、短横线（-）、下划线（_）。
长度限制在 3-64 个字符，多于 64 个字符将被自动截取。
一旦创建后不能再修改
parameters.name: consumer_id
